title: SDLC Task Result Reference v1
description: A durable reference to one exact SDLC task result, paired with the SHA-256 digest of the representation selected by the relationship.
$comment: The host must resolve ref, verify that it identifies a result belonging to the named task, and compare sha256 with the exact bytes or canonical representation used for the relationship. A digest-pinned reference is required when a later action reviews, corrects, or otherwise acts on a result.

ref.description: The task-local, task-qualified, or globally qualified reference to the result entity or durable result record.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 digest of the exact result representation identified by ref.
